title: Broaden the README and document the package
description:
**Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus.

**Milestone:** M1, first slice

**Goal.** MIT is in (AnthusAI/Caducus#4). Open the README with the new direction, that Caducus decides what deserves your attention and gets it to you, with the radar as one part. Document how a host uses `caducus.notify`: environment, handlers, kinds, catalog, renderer. Claims describe only what has shipped.

**Acceptance.**
README states the direction without claiming unbuilt features.
